scope: Actual support positive-E XY toolpath points sampled at <=1mm spacing; model-only point-ray tests in eight horizontal directions. Other support, cutter radius, hand access and extraction deformation are not modeled. This is not a full removal or swept-tool guarantee.

canopy_socket_bridge.note: Point/centerline overlap with previous solid section. Bridge-infill elsewhere may be over sparse infill rather than an external void; this does not evaluate cooling, sagging or fit.
